'''Mach Inc''' was located in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. One of their signs was located in the city [[Daiyu spaceport|spaceport]], with an [[Aurebesh]] writing saying "Mach Inc", "[[radar]] m<small>''[obscured]''</small>". Another was located in a [[Daiyu cargo port|cargo port]], saying "Mach Inc Mach Inc".<ref name="Kenobi" />
